title: Argentina, Spain and their stars Lionel Messi and Lamine Yamal meet in World Cup final
summary: Worry no more about wildfire smoke and $10,000 ticket prices. Sunday's final between Argentina and Spain — the first meeting of their transcendent stars — is here and seems destined to be a classic.
